our_interpretation: The efficiency-project reference is read as Arrakis, the project identified by the article linked from the post.
Late last year means late 2023, not the date on which an earlier failure was reported.
The linked GPT-4 discussion concerns changes between GPT-4 versions. Assess documented task regressions without converting them into a claim of overall inferiority.
The target year encloses the historical GPT-4 comparisons and the claimed late-2023 project event. The late-year qualifier is tested separately rather than discarded.
GPT-5 being meant to be materially better is background attribution, not a measurable forecast in the supplied proposition.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes the identified efficiency project's failure in late 2023 and at least one valid task regression against the relevant predecessor.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes that the identified project failed outside the stated late-2023 period, succeeded instead, or that the claimed task regressions do not hold under the relevant comparison.
